title: TransactionLog
description: Schema for every student interaction event. Inspired by TutorGym SAI triples and PSLC DataShop transaction format.

session_id.description: Session grouping for a continuous student work period

question_id.description: Reference to the specific question within the assignment

step_id.description: Reference to the specific scaffolding step within the question (e.g., q3_step_2)

action.description: The SAI (Selection-Action-Input) triple describing what the student did

input.description: The raw value or content submitted by the student

evaluation.description: The system's evaluation of the student's action

diagnosed_misconception.description: Misconception ID from the taxonomy (null if correct or no misconception identified)

knowledge_components.description: Knowledge component IDs tested by this interaction

hint_text.description: The actual hint text shown to the student

agent_internal_state.description: The 'Thoughts of Tutorbot' — the agent's observable internal reasoning (CLASS framework)

thoughts_of_tutorbot.description: Natural language reasoning trace explaining the agent's diagnostic and response decision

affective_read.description: Detected affective state of the student

student_state_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the student's knowledge state at the time of this interaction

additionalProperties.description: Mastery level for a knowledge component (0.0 to 1.0)
